findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a blocked change is repaired after an updated default branch is merged into it.
The prompt classifies design files against the previous reviewed commit, but `review.py:949-954` can reset the actual comparison base to the updated default branch. If the previous commit removed a `linguist-generated` attribute and updated a short-lined `PRODUCT.md`, `DESIGN.md`, or applicable `SCREENS.md`, neither that commit nor HEAD marks the file. The prompt therefore includes its full content, even though the actual comparison base still marks it generated and the diff filter omits it. A large generated design file can again exhaust the review input limit. The new design-context test covers only a first review, so it misses this repair-review case.

why: Issue 1728: a fix that deletes a large tracked build folder (89 files, 88.6 MB including a 75 MB source map and an 11.7 MB minified bundle, 40,208 lines deleted) can never be reviewed: close's review sends deleted, minified and source-map content to the model and hits the usage limit every time (3 of 3 tries, then the organization's spend limit); the client finished the pull request by hand
